title: vLEI / ACDC SAID Structural Checker
description: Recompute the self-addressing identifiers (SAIDs) of a pasted ACDC / vLEI credential (Blake3-256 or SHA2-256 CESR derivation codes) across the top-level and nested a/e/r blocks, and cross-check the schema SAID against a pinned table of official GLEIF vLEI schema SAIDs. Structural check only — not a KERI chain-of-trust verifier, not issuer authority, not revocation state. Paste-mode. Zero egress. Zero PII.

credential.description: ACDC / vLEI credential JSON object (pasted, never fetched)

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_acdc_said_structure
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recompute the SAIDs of a pasted ACDC/vLEI credential JSON (top-level and nested a/e/r blocks) and compare against declared values. Cross-checks the schema SAID against a pinned GLEIF vLEI schema table. Structural integrity check only — not KERI chain-of-trust verification, not issuer authority, not revocation status. Local compute only: no state change, no keys held, nothing issued or registered.
